{{Quote|And finally, ''Recon''. His sense of imminent d-danger was legendary, even amongst v-veteran scouts.|Sergeant Marrt|<ref name="Tale" />}}
'''Recon''' was the nickname of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[182nd Legion]]. A renowned [[Scout/Legends|scout]], Recon participated in a [[Mission to Belgaroth|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belgaroth]] which was aimed at investigating rumors of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Czerka factory]]'s dealings with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Recon and two other [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], [[Chatter]] and [[Knuckles (182nd Legion)|Knuckles]], were [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the mission by the native [[droidbreaker]] creature, though the last member of the team, [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Marrt]], successfully carried out the mission to the end.

==Biography==
{{Quote|He's&hellip;he's dead, Sarge.|Knuckles, to Sergeant Marrt, after inspecting Recon's body|<ref name="Tale" />}}
Recon was the nickname<ref name="Tale" /> of one of the numerous [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] from [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] to fight in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Databank" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Recon served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[182nd Legion]], and he earned his nickname for his exceptional skills in reconnaissance duties.<ref name="Tale" /> Between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="A Trooper's Tale date" /> rumors spread that the Republic [[Czerka factory]] on the planet [[Belgaroth]] was secretly dealing with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and the Republic responded by sending a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] team of four [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]&mdash;Recon, [[Chatter]], [[Knuckles (182nd Legion)|Knuckles]], and [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Marrt]]&mdash;to investigate.<ref name="Tale" />

[[File:Recon_death.jpg|thumb|left|100px|Recon is killed.]]
After reaching the factory, Marrt sneaked inside to scout ahead, while Recon and the rest waited nearby. Marrt found out that the facility's head, [[Tarin (Human)|Tarin]], was secretly supplying the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] representative [[Reep Tonith]] with illegal [[FEX-M3 nerve gas grenade]]s, which could be used to turn the tide of the war in favor of the Confederacy. The [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] took one [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] as evidence and attempted to slip away undetected but was spotted by one of Tonith's [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s. Tarin and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] opened fire, forcing the four clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to retreat to a swamp, which was covered by a thick fog that prevented the clones from sending a transmission to the Republic. Moreover, a high screech sounded throughout the swamp, and Knuckles suspected that more [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] had found them. Recon, however, realized that the sound was emitted by something much bigger than a droid, and that this "something" was coming their way.<ref name="Tale" />

Before he could do anything, Recon was attacked by the native [[droidbreaker]] creature. Marrt cried for Recon to move away, but the latter was not fast enough. The beast hit Recon with its hard head carapace, throwing him into a [[Tree/Legends|tree]]. Recon [[Death/Legends|died]] upon impact, and the droidbreaker began chewing on his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. One by one, Chatter and Knuckles fell victim to the droidbreaker as well, until Marrt killed the creature with the nerve grenade he had stolen. The sergeant buried his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] under the defeated creature's head. Vowing to avenge their deaths, he attacked the Czerka factory alone. Receiving heavy injuries during the fight against the battle droids, Marrt managed to single-handedly capture Tarin and obtain valuable evidence from the factory before burning it down. However, Tonith managed to escape.<ref name="Tale" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Recon was r-right, as always, but for the last time.|Marrt, commenting on Recon's final assessment|<ref name="Tale" />}}
Recon's talents laid in reconnaissance, which earned him his nickname, and he was respected even by veteran scouts for his skills. His sense of danger was well-known among other clone troopers, but it failed him on Belgaroth. Though he sensed the incoming danger, Recon was unable to evade the droidbreaker's attack.<ref name="Tale" /> Like all clone troopers, Recon stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="Databank" /> He also had [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair.<ref name="Tale" />

==Behind the scenes==
Recon was featured in ''[[A Trooper's Tale]]'', a short [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] strip published in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.8|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic UK 6.8]]'' in [[May]] of [[2010]]. ''A Trooper's Tale'' was written by [[Robin Etherington]] and illustrated by [[Andres Ponce]].<ref name="Tale" />
